shortDescription: JHTET Syllabus 2026 – Paper I and Paper II topics for teacher eligibility.
content:
Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JHTET) syllabus is structured for primary and upper primary teacher eligibility papers.

Paper overview

  • Paper I (Classes I–V): Child Development & Pedagogy, Language I, Language II, Mathematics, Environmental Studies
  • Paper II (Classes VI–VIII): Child Development & Pedagogy, Language I, Language II, Mathematics & Science or Social Studies

Download the latest official syllabus PDF from the conducting authority website.
